question: Does a knockdown apply on the shear-crimp branch?
answer: The handbook applies gamma 1 for Vc >= 2 and says a continuous transition is beyond its scope. Two estimate curves are scored here. The optimistic curve keeps gamma 1 on that branch. The conservative curve keeps 0.20. Neither is a test fit.

handbook.document: NASA CR-1457, Sullins, Smith and Spier, 1969
handbook.theory: Section 6.2. Yao, Journal of the Aerospace Sciences, March 1962, ref 6-1, reformulated by Plantema, Sandwich Construction, Wiley, 1966, ref 6-2.
handbook.step: Section 6.2.2, page 6-12. Vc < 2: Yd = 0.20 for hemispheres and 0.35 for ellipsoids and torispheres. Vc >= 2: Yd = 1 for those domes.
handbook.kc_boundary: Kc is 1 - Vc/4 for Vc <= 2 and 1/Vc for Vc > 2. Both give 1/2 at Vc = 2, so Kc is continuous. Yd is not.
handbook.implementation_note: MAINLINE-014 puts the gamma step on Vc > 2, with the Kc inequality. Page 6-12 puts Yd = 1 at Vc >= 2. No rescored row is exactly Vc = 2.
handbook.why_unity: Page 6-7. Sensitivity decreases as Vc goes from 0 to 2. Weak-core constructions are said not to be influenced by initial imperfections, so a knockdown of unity can be applied. A continuous transitional knockdown is beyond the scope of the handbook.
handbook.dome_tests: Section 6.2.1.2. Data very scarce. Gonzalez and Patton, North American Rockwell report SDL 468, May 1964, ref 6-4, Saturn S-II 55-inch bulkheads. Recommended 0.20 except where shear crimping occurs. The method is called best-available and not very reliable.
handbook.cylinder_weak_core: Section 4.2, Figs 4.2-4 and 4.2-5, refs 4-2 (March and Kuenzi, FPL 1830, revised December 1957) and 4-11 (Hexcel Products status summary, 25 July 1963). Axial compression, not external pressure. All but one test exceed the gamma-1 prediction. The exception is 0.86 of predicted. Individual Vc values are not tabulated. Class is Vc >= 2. Section 2.3 says no knockdown is required because crimping is insensitive, and that neglecting face bending is conservative and can be considerable.
handbook.transfer: QUESTIONABLE. Cylinder axial tests and a theory claim are not a sphere series at Vc > 2.

optimistic.source: Handbook endpoints on page 6-7. The linear bridge is not in the handbook.

conservative.source: Equation 6.2-13 extended onto Vc >= 2. The crimp exception is withheld.
conservative.how: Design pressure is gamma(Vc) * Kc * (4*tf/R) * sigma_0. On the crimp branch that equals gamma times the bare crimp pressure. Bare crimp, face, crush and wrinkling are not otherwise changed. gamma replaces kd. It is not stacked on 0.20, 0.90 or 0.1407.

curves.not_scored: The handbook step itself is the discontinuous rule, not one of the two continuous curves. A third curve at 0.86 is not scored. That 0.86 is one axial cylinder, not a sphere fit.

sim_2024.source_kdf: Sim, Lee, Kim, Park and Lee, Int. J. Aerospace Engineering, 2024, doi 10.1155/2024/8765733
sim_2024.kdf_denominator: Their own perfect-shell linear buckling load, not the CR-1457 allowable. Numerical, not a test.
sim_2024.Gc_basis: Isotropic conversion G = E/(2*(1+nu)) from the stated foam modulus 0.04 GPa and Poisson 0. The paper does not state Gc.

wagner_2020.sandwich_rows: none. The extract has no occurrence of sandwich. Table 3 is monocoque spherical shells, including PVC and aluminium. No sandwich Vc is computed from it.
wagner_2020.carried_from_004b: Equation 7 about 0.2 for elastic monocoque shells, deep-dome bound 0.21, Krenzke and Kiernan KDF 0.11 to 0.90. QUESTIONABLE if transferred onto this sandwich.

tests.sp_8032: Monocoque doubly curved shells. The monograph PDF was not retrieved. The cap rho = 0.14 + 3.2/lambda^2 is not a sandwich Vc curve. QUESTIONABLE transfer, already filed on MAINLINE-004.
tests.sp_8007: CR-1457 ref 4-4 is NASA SP-8007, September 1965, Buckling of Thin-Walled Circular Cylinders. The monograph was not opened. It is a cylinder document. No sandwich-sphere Vc series was taken from it.
tests.plantema: Not opened. Used only as CR-1457 ref 6-2 and ref 4-12.
tests.imperfection_analyses: No separate sandwich-sphere gamma(Vc) analysis with a DOI was opened. The sourced sensitivity statement is CR-1457 page 6-7. Sim 2024 is a numerical dimple study and does not report Vc.
